questions.prompt: How many teachers usually worked in a one-room schoolhouse?
questions.evidenceSnippet: There was usually one teacher and no principal.

questions.prompt: Students wrote on paper because it was cheap.
questions.evidenceSnippet: Students wrote on small slates, or blackboards, because paper was too expensive.

questions.prompt: Which famous American President went to a one-room schoolhouse?
questions.evidenceSnippet: Former United States President Lyndon Johnson attended a one-room schoolhouse in Texas. Johnson was born near Stonewall, Texas, in 1908.

questions.prompt: What happened to many old one-room schoolhouses after they closed as schools?
choices: They became museums, stores, or homes.
They were moved to other towns.
questions.evidenceSnippet: Some became museums. You can tour a school in South Dakota just like one that writer Laura Ingalls Wilder attended. Other schoolhouses became stores, restaurants, and homes.
